# PG Renewables (PlumbGas Renewables)

> Air source heat pump installation across Staffordshire, UK. PG Renewables is the renewables arm of PlumbGas Services, a Gas Safe and MCS certified, Which? Trusted Trader heating company based in Stafford, trading since 2003, rated 4.9 on Trustpilot with 270+ reviews. Core offer: a free heat loss survey leading to a fixed-price heat pump quote, with the £7,500 Boiler Upgrade Scheme grant handled by the installer. ZeroDisrupt heat pumps cost from around £3,000 installed after the grant, about the same as a new gas boiler.

Contact: 07872 626573, 27 Barnbank Lane, Stafford ST17 9HB.
Towns served: Stafford, Stone, Cannock, Rugeley, Uttoxeter, Stoke-on-Trent, Newcastle-under-Lyme, Lichfield, Tamworth, Burton upon Trent, Leek, Cheadle, Penkridge, Eccleshall, Gnosall, Brewood.
Brands installed: Vaillant, Viessmann, Daikin (5-16kW), with a 2-year workmanship warranty.
